title: Wedding Trip Stack Tetris
oneLiner: Wedding guests fit flights, outfits, gifts, PTO, and guilt into a budget block puzzle before the season overflows.
theme: wedding guest budget, social pressure, travel planning
targetUser: Wedding guests, friend groups, couples attending multiple events, and social-budget content creators.
keyUX: Drag wedding obligations into a season grid, stack shared lodging and outfits, watch guilt and budget meters, and export a polite decline or attendance plan.
sourceSignalReferences: S13 MarketWatch wedding guest cost pressure
S14 viral prop-hunt and fast social game loops
stitchPrompt: Build a polished web prototype called "Wedding Trip Stack Tetris" for guests juggling too many weddings in one season. The first screen should show wedding events as draggable budget blocks, a season grid, shared lodging and outfit reuse lanes, gift and PTO costs, a guilt meter, and exportable attend/decline cards. Required sections: wedding event queue, season budget grid, trip-stack blocks, outfit and gift reuse lane, guilt meter, and plan/decline card export. Design direction: use the financial-analyst profile with crisp budget math, playful block-grid structure, tasteful social-pressure cues, and clean cards that feel shareable.
